evals.prompt: I want to add rate limiting to this API. It needs per-endpoint limits configured in YAML, a shared Redis store so all instances count together, and it must not add more than 5ms to p99 latency. ESDD this feature for me.
evals.expected_output: Full ESDD pipeline: .esdd scaffolded (or reused), spec 'rate-limit' with INVEST-checked proposal.md, utility-tree.md with ASRs and H/M/L-ranked QAS (latency QAS with numeric measure), design.md with C4 + sequence diagrams, spec-level MADR ADRs, Taskwarrior task graph under project <ws>.core.rate-limit with blocking edges, estimates under 100k, index task with synced adrs UDA. Human must be grilled during the run (scripted answers: yes to defaults, per-endpoint limits negotiable, team owns Redis ops).
evals.notes: Interactive: the runner must answer INVEST/QAW/ranking questions with the scripted answers above. Assertions to draft at run time: file existence, QAS measure numeric, project naming, verify passes.

evals.notes: Requires a pre-seeded .esdd workspace with a checkout spec. Assert utility-tree sections filled, design.md untouched, zero tasks in Taskwarrior project.
